structure.unit: Uniform Adult Guardianship and Protective Proceedings Jurisdiction Act

law.text: A court of the Commonwealth may treat a foreign country as if it were a state for the purpose of applying this article and Articles 2 (§ 64.2-2105 et seq.), 3 (§ 64.2-2114 et seq.), and 5 (§ 64.2-2119 et seq.).
